  <p class="title">Solid Earth Dynamics</p>
  <p>Mapping where distinct mantle reservoirs sit, how plumes sample them, and how they shape volcanism at hotspots, mid-ocean ridges and subduction zones, using geodynamical modeling, laboratory experiments and geophysical and geochemical observations.</p>

<div class="body">
  <p class="title">Surface Processes and Interior-surface Coupling</p>
  <p>How ice sheets, sea level and the solid Earth respond to one another across timescales, from sea-level fingerprints and glacial isostatic adjustment to volatile cycling, with implications for planetary evolution and habitability.</p>
  <p><a href="research-couple.qmd">Read more →</a></p>

<div class="body">
  <p class="title">Experimental, Computational and AI Methods in Geophysics</p>
  <p>Developing laboratory 4D flow measurements, hybrid-adjoint digital twins, fast physics-based solvers and neural operators to analyze, simulate and invert complex geodynamic systems.</p>
